text: The City Clerk's Office received notice that Danyaal Raza resigned from the Housing Rights Advisory Committee effective September 23, 2024. Staff from the Public Appointments Secretariat in the City Clerk's Office are leading a process to recruit applicants and help bring a nominated candidate to City Council for their consideration.
The Housing Rights Advisory Committee accepted the resignation of Danyaal Raza as a member effective September 23, 2024.
